b: Note: This obviously excludes men who go for underage women. That is disgusting and evil.

I see a lot online that dudes from the west who go to a 3rd world country to meet and date women are pathetic at best, and predators at worst. I used to think that, and then I spoke to my cousin who is 40, and it really made me realize how judgmental we are of someone in his shoes.

He is 5’4 and about 125 pounds, so naturally dating is really hard for him in the US. He’s by no means a bad guy. He has friends, and a respectable job with a middle class salary, and pretty normal views of the world. He is a bit nerdy and slightly socially awkward, but nothing super severe, and he admits it comes from being picked on in school a lot.

He had one gf his entire life which he got in his 30s, where it left him feeling exploited and taken advantage of. He admitted that he should’ve ended it earlier, but because the fear of being alone felt so strong, it was really hard for him let go of a toxic relationship.

So he took a vacation to SE Asia and for the first time in his life he got to feel like a desired man. Do a lot od the women there desire him because of his US passport? Sure. However, it also just makes him naturally more attractive He was also the average height there so that helped too.

There is a saying that looks get you through the door, but connection is what keeps you going. Who are we to say someone from a 1st-world country can’t fall in love and have a real connection with someone from a 3rd-world country? People like my cousin do strongly desire for a real connection, and he’s certainly capable of it. He just needed more opportunities to get you in the door.

A lot of people will argue well, wouldn’t a lot of women overseas just take advantage of him, marry for the passport and bounce? Sure. However, now that he’s sexually active he’s able to not look at every girl who gives him attention with rose colored glasses, and can actually ask himself who does he truly share a bond with? Which of these girls truly likes his personality, and isn’t just using him to get a green card.

So instead of seeing all passport bros as bad creepy dudes, I think we should acknowledge guys like my cousin, and realize a lot of them are being practical. I also ask what’s a guy like my cousin supposed to do? Does he not deserve love and affection like everyone else? In most other forms of life he was doing ok. Not perfect, but hardly problematic. He couldn’t fix hsi height, and I’m sure someone will say “Not every woman cares about height. He should have found a woman who won’t be bothered by that.”
Great. You know who doesn’t care about height? Women in SE Asia.
